subject.title: v2026.6.x system prompt bloat causes instruction following degradation on smaller models

question: Should OpenClaw address this smaller-model regression by changing default prompt priority/scoping, by routing it into existing context-budget and skill-loading product tracks, or by documenting opt-in lean mode as the supported workaround for now?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the durable fix would change how OpenClaw ranks platform rules, user/workspace instructions, skill content, and default tool/context surfaces for existing users.

options.title: Define Priority And Scoping Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose a model-aware prompt/skill/tool scoping policy and require smaller-model proof before default changes.

options.title: Fold Into Canonical Trackers
options.body: Move the unique MiMo and activated-skill examples into the related context-budget and skill-loading issues, then close this only after a single canonical owner is explicit.

options.title: Document Lean Mode Only
options.body: Treat current opt-in localModelLean and Tool Search controls as the supported workaround, accepting that the reported default regression remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Define Priority And Scoping Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose a model-aware prompt/skill/tool scoping policy and require smaller-model proof before default changes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent prompt and skills surface history among the identified owners.
